name: apple-agent-kit
description: Build authentic Apple apps for agents. Three skills: macos-app-design (HIG conformance, menu bar, multi-window, keyboard shortcuts, system primitives, icon, accessibility), liquid-glass (macOS 26 glass material, NavigationSplitView, NSGlassEffectView, anti-patterns, performance budget, shaders), and design-custom-macos-apps (distinctive custom UI that keeps Mac behavior: customization levels, glass strategy, maintenance cost, review checklist). iOS coverage coming.
